name: adsb-radar
description: Radar ADS-B 1090 MHz local/offline: API (Fastify + WebSocket) y mapa (React + MapLibre).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @adsb/server" "npm run dev -w @adsb/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @adsb/web && npm run build -w @adsb/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @adsb/shared && npm run typecheck -w @adsb/server && npm run typecheck -w @adsb/web
